style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and variant rows, misty blush #F7ECF2 for info and closing shots, pale blue-grey #EDF1F7 and warm beige #E9DFD3 reserved for scene and silhouette panels
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color, empty tile style for care and spec rows
style.lightingSystem: warm soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; scene shots use 5200-5500K ambient daylight
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sweet-premium children outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, misty blush #F7ECF2, charcoal text #33383D and one rose accent #D6336C; warm soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern rounded geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end children fashion photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for worn shots and straight-on eye-level for display rows; garment always shown full length or as declared detail crop
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio sweep, soft painted wall panels and smooth rose satin lining as the only reflective surface
